story: Todd Snider was a beloved folk storyteller long before he played Pickathon in 2012, the year he put out two albums in seven weeks on his own Aimless Records: Agnostic Hymns & Stoner Fables in March and Time As We Know It, a Jerry Jeff Walker tribute produced by Don Was, in April. He said Walker was the performer he saw at 19 and decided to be like. The Americana Music Association had nominated him for Artist of the Year in 2007. He died in November 2025, and a posthumous album, My Second Rodeo, followed.
